test_rename_columns_mapping: test the DataFrame.rename method with a dictionary mapping column names to new names
test_rename_columns_function: test the DataFrame.rename method applying str.lower as a function to rename all columns
test_rename_index_mapping: test the DataFrame.rename method with a dictionary mapping index labels to new labels
test_rename_multiindex_levels: test the DataFrame.rename method on MultiIndex index and columns with level parameter
test_rename_errors_parameter: test the DataFrame.rename method with errors parameter set to raise or ignore
